purpose: Four design proposals; not runtime audio measurements
needleCorrection: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached VoiceDucker UI design proposal. Change ONLY the analog meter needles. Both needles currently float with a gap before their pivot: fix that mechanical defect. In each L and R meter, draw one continuous thin red/orange needle whose lower end is visibly attached to the exact center of its black circular pivot; the needle should emerge from underneath that pivot, and extend all the way to its existing upper tip on the graduated scale. The black pivot hides the needle origin cleanly. Keep the same needle upper tip positions. Preserve every other pixel as closely as possible: all text and spelling, font, colors, meter faces, borders, volume slider, header, spectrum bars, image size, and layout. Do not add any controls or objects.
studioBlueFinalCorrection: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is an edit of the STUDIO BLUE VoiceDucker mockup. REBUILD ONLY THE TWO ANALOG METER INTERIORS so each instrument is mechanically coherent. Put each black circular needle pivot fully inside the cream meter face near the lower center, clearly above the bottom frame. Move the small 'VU' lettering out of the way to the lower-left area of each cream face. Redraw a straight thin continuous red needle in each gauge, starting underneath the center of the black pivot and ending at the existing scale position (left near -3, right near 0). The entire needle must visibly connect to its pivot; there must be no gap, floating pointer, or label in its path. Keep the scale, L and R labels, cream background, colors and studio-blue style. Preserve everything outside the two meter faces: every header, checkbox, slider, Spotify icon, typography, spectrum, dimensions and card layout. Deliver the corrected final image.

variants.name: 01-hi-fi-crema
variants.title: 01 · Hi-Fi crema
variants.style: Visual direction: 1970s hi-fi meter faces in aged cream with black condensed monospace numbers, dark navy charcoal outer frames, warm orange-red needles, small subtle metallic border details, amber/orange spectrum bars. Light ivory Spotify card harmonizes with the existing app. Calm vintage audio equipment, polished restraint, highly readable. Small caption at top: "01 / HI-FI CREMA".
variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: one finished design proposal for the VoiceDucker Windows desktop app's advanced audio streams area. Create a straight-on, sharp, flat-on-screen UI mockup, landscape image, not a photo of a physical device. Keep the layout practical for a narrow desktop window: a light warm ivory app background, heading "ADVANCED OPTIONS", a checked checkbox labelled "SHOW VISUALIZERS", heading "ACTIVE AUDIO STREAMS", then one Spotify app card. Card header has a small green Spotify icon, exact label "SPOTIFY", and "85%" aligned right; below it a separate horizontal volume slider. Below the slider show two genuine-looking ANALOG NEEDLE VU GAUGES side by side labelled "L" and "R": each has a printed curved graduated scale marked "-20 -10 -5 0 +3", red over-range ticks, a physical-looking pivot and a thin angled needle. Different realistic needle positions. Under those gauges place a compact real audio SPECTRUM visualization with 24 uneven vertical frequency bars and labels "BASS", "MID", "TREBLE". The gauges must look like analog hi-fi meters with needles, not progress bars or fake digital numbers. All labels use readable retro computing monospace / bitmap-inspired typography. Text hierarchy is crisp, controls visibly usable. No extra options, menus, knobs, screen chrome, branding slogans, perspective or neon glow. This is a static DESIGN PROPOSAL illustrating the future animated needles and spectrum; waveform and spectrogram are not needed. Visual direction: 1970s hi-fi meter faces in aged cream with black condensed monospace numbers, dark navy charcoal outer frames, warm orange-red needles, small subtle metallic border details, amber/orange spectrum bars. Light ivory Spotify card harmonizes with the existing app. Calm vintage audio equipment, polished restraint, highly readable. Small caption at top: "01 / HI-FI CREMA".
